judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the initial test-writing/planning phase (adding `.lore/dod.md`, an in-progress `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, and `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`) without actually implementing any of the production code. Specifically, `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `package.json` (adding `ajv`) are completely untouched. Because the acceptance tests assert the new validation behavior against the unmodified `ToolRegistry`, the test suite will fail immediately. Furthermore, none of the required unit tests (`registry.test.ts`, `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`) or documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) were delivered.
